translated_title: Mexico Rejects Considering Nicaragua’s Crisis a Regional Threat at the OAS
original_title: México rechaza considerar crisis de Nicaragua una amenaza regional ante la OEA
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez and Iván Saldaña
meta_description: At the OAS, Mexico’s representative Alejandro Encinas rejected labeling Nicaragua’s crisis a regional security threat—warning it could “deepen isolation” and exceed the OAS’s powers—and Mexico abstained on a US-backed resolution.
